image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a dark blue and white minibus (resembling a Suzuki Carry or similar microbus). The vehicle features a boxy front end, a large windshield with wipers, a side sliding door area, and visible text decals on the side. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground. The background shows a brick wall and some foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. The side profile suggests a sliding door mechanism typical for this class, located at the mid-body.
The seam lines and handle placement on the side indicate a sliding door structure, common for minibuses.
The short hood/nose section ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout (or cab-over with small nose), consistent with the visual data.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is completely outside the frame; only the front and side are visible.

The grille slats and headlight integration show slight misalignment and softness. The bumper curve near the wheel well lacks sharp definition, appearing slightly melted into the fender.
